title: KestrelCare Prepaid Maintenance Plans Terms of Sale, Start and Expiration
content:
**1. Eligible vehicles.** A KestrelCare Prepaid Maintenance Plans plan is sold on a gasoline, hybrid or, where the plan allows it, diesel vehicle within the plan's age and odometer limits. Battery-electric vehicles and vehicles in commercial use are not eligible. The maximum model age and odometer at sale, and whether diesel is allowed, are set for each plan level.

**2. When a plan may be bought.** A plan is sold either with the vehicle or within the post-sale purchase window after handover, counted in calendar days after the vehicle's handover date.

**3. Start date.** A plan sold with the vehicle starts on the handover date. A plan bought after handover starts on its sale date.

**4. Expiration.** The expiration date is the start date plus the term months of the plan level. The expiration odometer is the odometer at sale plus the term miles of the plan level. Both appear on the plan record.

**5. Visits.** The plan's visits are credited at sale: the plan level's number of prepaid visits included. Visits are credited only on a plan whose status is active.

**6. Financing of the plan price.** The price may be financed only when the plan is sold with the vehicle on a Kestrel Auto Finance purchase within the finance tier's back-end limit.

## Clauses 2 to 4 worked through (hypothetical dates and readings)

The dates and odometer readings below are example inputs only; the term figures are those of the levels named.

| Example | Handover date | Plan sale date | Start date | Term | Expiration date | Odometer at sale | Expiration odometer |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| KestrelCare Maintenance Standard sold with the vehicle | 2026-04-15 | 2026-04-15 | 2026-04-15 | 24 months, 20000 miles | 2028-04-15 | 42310 | 62310 |
| KestrelCare Maintenance Starter bought after handover | 2026-04-15 | 2026-06-01 | 2026-06-01 | 12 months, 10000 miles | 2027-06-01 | 45100 | 55100 |

**Post-sale window boundary.** With a handover date of 2026-04-15 and a window of 90 calendar days, the 90th calendar day after handover is 2026-07-14: a plan bought on 2026-07-14 is within the window, and a plan bought on 2026-07-15 is not.

## Points of judgement

| Question at sale | Answer under these terms |
|---|---|
| Is the vehicle battery-electric, or in commercial use? | If either, not eligible |
| Is the vehicle diesel? | Eligible only where the plan level allows diesel |
| Is the plan sold with the vehicle? | If so, it starts on the handover date; if bought later, it starts on its sale date |
| Is the plan price to be financed? | Only for a plan sold with the vehicle on a Kestrel Auto Finance purchase within the finance tier's back-end limit |
| Is the plan's status active? | Visits are credited only on an active plan |
